inspire.Description: VitalDB Open Dataset containing perioperative patient data including operations, diagnoses, vital signs, laboratory results, and medications

operations.Description: Main operations table containing patient demographics, operation details, and timing information for surgical procedures

op_id.description: A random number starts with 4 for the operation.

subject_id.description: A random number starts with 1 for the patient.

hadm_id.description: A random number starts with 2 for hospital admission.

case_id.description: A linker to VitalDB Open Dataset

age.description: Age of the patient on the operation date

asa.description: American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status classification (1/2/3/4/5)

orin_time.description: The time for entering the operating room (Relative Time)

orout_time.description: The time for leaving the operating room (Relative Time)

opstart_time.description: The time for starting the operation (Relative Time)

opend_time.description: The time for finishing the operation (Relative Time)

admission_time.description: The time for hospital admission (Relative Time)

discharge_time.description: The time for hospital discharge (Relative Time)

anstart_time.description: The time for starting anaesthesia (Relative Time)

anend_time.description: The time for finishing anaesthesia (Relative Time)

cpbon_time.description: The time for starting cardiopulmonary bypass (Relative Time)

cpboff_time.description: The time for finishing cardiopulmonary bypass (Relative Time)

icuin_time.description: The time for ICU admission after surgery (Relative Time)

icuout_time.description: The time for ICU discharge after surgery (Relative Time)

inhosp_death_time.description: The time for in-hospital death (Relative Time)

allcause_death_time.description: The time for all-cause death (Relative Time)

diagnosis.Description: Patient diagnosis information with ICD-10 diagnosis codes recorded at specific times

subject_id.description: The patient identifier defined in the operations table

chart_time.description: The time for the diagnosis recorded (Relative Time)

vitals.Description: Vital signs measurements during operations with timestamped values

op_id.description: Operation identifier defined in the operations table

subject_id.description: The patient identifier defined in the operations table

chart_time.description: The time for the measurement recorded (Relative Time)

ward_vitals.Description: Ward vital signs measurements with timestamped values outside of operating room

subject_id.description: The patient identifier defined in the operations table

chart_time.description: The time for the measurement recorded (Relative Time)

labs.Description: Laboratory test results with timestamped values for patients

subject_id.description: The patient identifier defined in the operations table

chart_time.description: The time for the measurement recorded (Relative Time)

medications.Description: Medication administration records with drug names, routes, and ATC codes

subject_id.description: The patient identifier defined in the operations table

chart_time.description: The time for the medication administration recorded (Relative Time)
